commentary: Directional accuracy (49.1%) near 50% is mathematically consistent with Eugene Fama's Weak-Form Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) for liquid commodity futures. However, the deep LSTM + Attention network captures multi-scale volatility clustering and non-linear momentum, achieving an R² of 0.351 and reducing test MAPE by -174.4% compared to the linear ARIMA baseline (15.46% vs 5.64%).
